entities.name: CoaBC bifunctional enzyme
observations: 400 aa bacterial protein with Flavoprotein PF02441 domain at residues 2–177 and DFP PF04127 domain at residues 184–393.
Strongest homologs are reviewed Vibrio CoaBC proteins with 47.5–48.8% identity and 94.8–96.5% coverage.
Catalyzes two sequential CoA-biosynthesis reactions: phosphopantothenate–cysteine ligation and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenate cysteine ligation
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H(+).
Annotated as EC 6.3.2.5 and Rhea RHEA:19397 for CoaBC homologs.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation
observations: Annotated as EC 4.1.1.36 and Rhea RHEA:16793 for CoaBC homologs.

entities.name: CoaBC cofactors
observations: Reviewed CoaBC homologs bind FMN, one FMN per subunit, and require Mg2+.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC performs steps 2 and 3 of bacterial CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate.
